meta.title: The Last Tea — Eight Scene Production Plan
meta.logline: A tea seller gets one last chance with the woman who left.
meta.synopsis: During a rainy night and a dawn departure, Meera and Ravi learn that supporting a new beginning can preserve their relationship. Four-minute planning estimate; 24 shots at 10 seconds each. All production specifications are planning assumptions awaiting crew review.

script:
INT. TEA STALL - NIGHT #1#

Meera shelters under the tin roof. Ravi sets down a glass.
@RAVI
I kept your seat.
@MEERA
I almost did not come.
CUT TO:

INT. TEA STALL - NIGHT #1A#

Meera places a railway appointment letter between them.
@RAVI
The morning train?
@MEERA
A new job. A real beginning.
CUT TO:

INT. TEA STALL - NIGHT #1B#

Ravi reaches for the letter, then stops. Meera watches his hand.
@RAVI
I could ask you to stay.
@MEERA
Ask me what I want.
CUT TO:

INT. TEA STALL - NIGHT #2#

Ravi meets her eyes. The kettle falls silent.
@RAVI
What do you want?
@MEERA
To leave without losing this.
CUT TO:

INT. TEA STALL - DAWN #3#

Ravi turns the sign to CLOSED and picks up the umbrella.
@RAVI
Then I will walk you there.
@MEERA
Just to the platform.
CUT TO:

EXT. STATION PLATFORM - DAWN #4#

They stand beneath the platform lamp. A train approaches through mist.
@RAVI
I thought leaving meant an ending.
@MEERA
It can be a promise.
CUT TO:

EXT. STATION PLATFORM - DAWN #4A#

Ravi offers the red umbrella to Meera. She closes her hand around it.
@RAVI
For the next rain.
@MEERA
You will need it too.
CUT TO:

EXT. STATION PLATFORM - DAWN #4B#

Meera boards with the umbrella. Ravi stays behind the safety line.
@RAVI
Call when you arrive.
@MEERA
I will. Keep my seat.
FADE OUT.

skills.name: Intimate Drama
skills.body:
---
name: Intimate Drama
type: direction
---
# Intimate Drama
- Favor close coverage when emotion peaks.
- Hold on reactions longer than lines.
- Let silence play; cut on looks, not words.

# Naturalistic Light
- Motivated sources only.
- 35mm and 50mm primes, f/2-2.8.
- Handheld for emotional scenes.

skills.name: Continuity and timing

# Continuity and timing

Preserve the line of action; cut on reactions and budget every shot in frames.

skills.name: Rain to dawn palette

Preserve skin tones and red umbrella; move from warm amber interiors to cool blue dawn.

skills.name: Rain and rail soundscape
skills.body:
# Rain and rail soundscape

Prioritize dialogue, maintain rain beds and use the train horn to bridge the scene transition.
